335:t_1:166.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バアル$$... So its appearance really was the first step toward the collapse of the universe?」

335:t_1:167.en:
$$トライア$$
「Rather than a first step, it looks like the very means of the collapse.」

335:t_1:168.en:
$$トライア$$
「Though we still haven't determined what the death of life forms has to do with the universe being reborn.」

335:t_1:169.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, until now it was only an abstract concept. This reveals part of the concrete course of the universe's collapse.」

335:t_1:170.en:
$$桂$$
「So basically, if we don't lose to $$バアル$$, the universe won't collapse.」

335:t_1:171.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes... The world of $$ノリコ$$ and the others, who destroyed the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$, must have survived that way.」

335:t_1:172.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then as long as we don't lose to $$バアル$$, we can protect the universe!」

335:t_1:173.en:
$$トライア$$
「Probably, but it's too early to celebrate. The ruins left these words as well.」

335:t_1:174.en:
$$トライア$$
「Those who open the door of $$シンカ$$ will stand against the end of the universe... And that will become the power to overcome the true end that is yet to come...」

335:t_1:176.en:
$$トライア$$
「12,000 years... Repeat that ten thousand times, and the universe meets its true end...」

335:t_1:177.en:
$$トライア$$
「That is the final battle... The force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist will clash with everything they have...」

335:t_1:178.en:
$$トライア$$
「It will drag in every parallel world that exists.」

335:t_1:180.en:
$$モーム$$
「12,000 years, ten thousand times... So that means 120 million years?」

335:t_1:181.en:
$$トライア$$
「That must be it. ...The passage closes with this.」

335:t_1:182.en:
$$トライア$$
「The power to overcome that true end is the pinnacle of $$シンカ$$... in other words, the power of God...」

335:t_1:183.en:
$$トライア$$
「God and devil... The battle between the higher life forms and $$バアル$$... That is the way to overcome the end...」

335:t_1:185.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The $$ミケーネ神$$ said something similar...」

335:t_1:186.en:
$$トライア$$
「Several other documents survived too, but we're still analyzing those.」

335:t_1:187.en:
$$トライア$$
「There are a lot of rather convoluted concepts. A higher mission, emissaries of God, and so on. Some of it is more than I can handle.」

335:t_1:188.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Whatever that true end turns out to be, learning the mechanism of the universe's collapse is a big gain.」

335:t_1:189.en:
$$桂$$
「The problem is whether today's Earth can beat $$バアル$$.」

335:t_1:190.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バアル$$... the natural enemy of humanity... It is said to come from the center of the galaxy.」

335:t_1:191.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And according to the data $$レド$$ provided, the main force of the $$サイデリアル$$ is deployed in the galactic core.」

335:t_1:192.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Are they fighting $$バアル$$ there?」

335:t_1:194.en:
$$マオ$$
「In that case, the $$次元力$$ extracted on Earth must be meant for use in that fight too.」

335:t_1:196.en:
$$トライア$$
「They aren't the only ones opposed to $$バアル$$. If they had just said so honestly, even Earth might have cooperated.」

335:t_1:197.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But the $$サイデリアル$$ chose invasion as their means.」

335:t_1:198.en:
$$カレン$$
「I have no desire to cooperate with people like that.」

335:t_1:199.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's fair. ...I'll keep analyzing the documents on my end. If I find anything, I'll tell you.」

335:t_1:200.en:
$$トライア$$
「Countermeasures against $$バアル$$ matter too, but first we deal with the $$サイデリアル$$ in front of us.」

335:t_1:202.en:
$$桂$$
「Getting by with this force is tough, but that's no reason to throw in the towel.」

335:t_1:203.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's the spirit. I'm expecting a lot from you.」

335:t_1:204.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you run into that debt-ridden drifter, tell him to pay back my money already.」

335:t_1:206.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Must be $$クロウ$$. Can't be anyone else.」

335:t_1:207.en:
$$カトル$$
「So it's $$クロウ$$ after all... It seems he still hasn't finished paying off his debts from the $$再世戦争$$.」

335:t_1:208.en:
$$トロワ$$
「That man hasn't changed, has he...」

335:t_1:210.en:
$$研究員$$
「I just found out. I never knew Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$ had a child.」

335:t_1:211.en:
$$研究員$$
「I heard she died in an accident in her thirties. I went into research because her papers moved me.」

335:t_1:212.en:
$n
「...I told Dr. $$トライア$$ too, but I... hardly remember Mom at all...」

335:t_1:214.en:
$n
「...I have $$ジェニオン$$ maintenance to do, so if you'll excuse me.」

335:t_1:216.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That was hard mode for the first time in a while.」

335:t_1:218.en:
$$マオ$$
「He's shut people out before, but this time is different from those.」

335:t_1:219.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I sensed a wall in a darker, deeper place... the innermost part of his heart.」

335:t_1:220.en:
$$研究員$$
「...I'm sorry. It seems I asked about something I shouldn't have.」

335:t_1:221.en:
$$マオ$$
「Don't worry about it. We'll follow up with $n on our end.」

335:t_1:222.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah, yeah. Right, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

335:t_1:225.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... I'm sorry... Hearing Dr. $$トライア$$'s story made my head spin...」

335:t_1:226.en:
$$宗介$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s love of the occult really runs deep.」

335:t_1:227.en:
$$研究員$$
「But I was surprised. That Dr. $$メグミ$$ was studying archaeology at the same time as super-dimensional physics...」

335:t_1:228.en:
$$研究員$$
「So Dr. $$トライア$$ was influenced by Dr. $$メグミ・ラクナルド$$ too.」

335:t_1:229.en:
$$カレン$$
「Um... may I ask you something?」

335:t_1:231.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you know a girl named $$エスター・エルハス$$...?」

335:t_1:232.en:
$$研究員$$
「You mean $$エスター$$, the $$次元獣$$ Buster. When she was at this lab, we often went out to lunch together.」

335:t_1:235.en:
$$カレン$$
「Did something happen to $$エスター$$!?」

335:t_1:239.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is an area where the Empire's forces and Earth's are evenly matched.」

335:t_1:240.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are coming...!」

335:t_2:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what on earth is it for...」
